svg.title: kernelkite: sample the process subtree, land a deterministic bundle
svg.desc: Left to right data flow. A launched command forks a subtree of processes. kernelkite samples the subtree from /proc on a fixed interval, collecting CPU, RSS and IO counters into ordered frames, then writes a deterministic bundle that can be summarized, diffed, and rendered. Flat two-color palette, no remote assets.
